landing.heroTitle1: What would you say to those you love
landing.heroSubtitle: Aevum is your timeless digital vault for the future. Store letters, photos, audios, and videos protected by advanced security until the exact moment of awakening.
landing.problemTitle: In a world of fleeting messages, where is eternity kept?
landing.problemText: Chat histories get lost on replaced phones, social media feeds vanish, and precious photos disappear in cluttered clouds. Aevum was conceived for what cannot be forgotten: a digital sanctuary with long-term custody built to last generations.
landing.stepsTitle: Simple to forge. Secure as a centuries-old vault.
landing.stepsSubtitle: In just 3 solemn steps, your legacy is immortalized in the flow of time.
landing.step1Desc: Select the artistic reliquary of your capsule — from classic golden oak with bronze hardware to ancestral and mystical themes.
landing.step2Desc: Deposit heartfelt letters, high-resolution photographs, recordings with your own voice, or films that mark your history.
landing.step3Desc: Set the day and year of awakening — tomorrow or 50 years from now. Your data is encrypted and preserved in cold storage until the exact date.
landing.useCase1Desc: Record letters and videos for your children to open on their 18th birthday, graduation, or wedding day.
landing.useCase2Desc: Lock deepest vows and sentiments from your wedding day to be revealed together on your 10th, 20th, or 30th anniversary.
landing.useCase3Desc: Send an honest message to yourself 5 years from now. Recall your ambitions, promises, and celebrate your personal growth.
landing.useCase4Desc: Gather friends and family to create a collective chest and surprise someone special on a milestone date.
landing.securitySubtitle: How do we guarantee your memories will be there decades from now?
landing.securityItem1Desc: Your files are sealed by mathematical cryptographic keys. No one has access to your content prior to the awakening date.
landing.securityItem2Desc: We utilize state-of-the-art cloud technology to store your data in high-redundancy vaults, engineered against any data loss.
landing.securityItem3Desc: With the Total Lock rule, your promise is shielded against temptation: the capsule will only awaken on the date you specified.
landing.faqQ1: Can I open the chest before the chosen date?
landing.faqA1: Yes, if you configured the 'Emergency Key' when creating the capsule. If you chose 'Total Lock', the capsule remains locked until the stipulated date.
landing.faqQ2: How does the recipient access the capsule?
landing.faqA2: On the exact day of awakening, our automated system dispatches a solemn email to the recipient with the secure link and key to unlock and explore the chest.
landing.faqQ3: How does payment and custody work?
landing.faqA3: You choose your reliquary theme and the awakening date. Payment is made as a transparent, one-time flat fee when you decide to seal the capsule — ensuring safe custody and delivery without monthly fees or recurring subscriptions.
landing.faqQ4: What if Aevum ceases to exist in the future?
landing.faqA4: Aevum has a formal Custody and Contingency Protocol with pre-funded reserves and automated release safeguards to ensure memories are safely delivered to their owners.
landing.ctaFinalTitle: What memory do you want to send to the future?
landing.ctaFinalSubtitle: Lock away today what time must never erase. Your memories securely preserved for future generations.
